sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about experiences using már and még soha nem with past tense.
I can mark and describe a first-time experience, and use past-participle adjectives to describe people and things.
I can use the full set of experience, memory and reflection words from this unit.
I can compare my past and present experiences and talk about how I've changed.
